description: Extend the just-validated fp16-with-fp32-accumulate GEMM precision (a sibling proved it gate-clean and ~2x on shape 11's iteration-count-limited Newton-Schulz sign GEMMs, nbad 0/640) to the LOW-RANK PEEL + cluster-path GEMMs that serve shapes 3/4/8/10/12 — a broader set of geomean shapes than the sign-DC pipeline. Cast the low-rank projection / A@Omega range / back-transform GEMMs (not the CholeskyQR2 potrf/trsm, which are precision-sensitive orthonormalization) to fp16 in, fp32 accumulate, cast once out, per-GEMM-site gated by the residual gate so any precision-sensitive site stays higher precision. Targets compute-throughput (fp16 tensor cores at 2x fp32/tf32) on the many-shape low-rank family; keep the per-matrix residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape.

t1: profile shapes 3/4/8/10/12 + LR_GATE_DBG diagnostic. Parent 27327us. FP32-SIMT simt_sgemm GEMMs are the fp16 lever (~4-6ms/512-shape). Gate margins (rel to gate): s3 eig0.760/orth0.752 nbad0; s4 0.776/0.522 nbad0; s8 0.661/3.264 nbad1(rescued); s10 0.399/0.415 nbad0; s12 0.922/0.561 nbad0. Shape10 most headroom, s12 tight eig, s8 at orth edge.

t2: fp16 on A@X matvecs (av_mode) shapes 3/4/10/12. REGRESSION 27327->27505. The matvecs were ALREADY tf32 tensor-core in parent -> fp16 gives little TC speedup while casts add launches + fp16 error inflates orth margin: s3 74.31->77.89ms orth 0.752->1.503 nbad0->1; s4 45.52->46.33 orth->0.531 nbad0; s10 90.66->90.33 orth 0.415->1.946 nbad0->1; s12 29.91->31.23 orth->0.892 nbad0. Lever is the FP32-SIMT simt_sgemm (Vd lift, n=512 projections), not the tf32 matvecs. Pivoting.

t3: fp16 on Vd lift (back-transform Vd=Qd@G) + n=512 projections. CATASTROPHIC 27327->35983. Vd forms DOMINANT eigenvectors; fp16 error breaks V orth -> 100% cuSOLVER fallback: s3 74.3->229.2ms; s4 45.5->74.2 orth 0.522->1.256 nbad60/60; s8 80.9->231.9; s10 90.7->118.7 orth->1.463 nbad60/60; s12 29.9->58.7 orth->1.183 nbad60/60. DECISIVE: Vd lift is PRECISION-limited not compute-limited (dominant eigenvectors need >fp16). Vd lift + n=512 proj OUT. Gate held -> still correct.

t4: fp16 on orth-independent matvecs (A@Omega range + A@Vc Rayleigh), split per-matvec. Net loss 27327->27535. PROFILE (shape3) confirms: the FP32-SIMT simt_sgemm 128x128 (4.75ms, the CQR2 Gram) is UNCHANGED (correctly left fp32); NO fp16 GEMM appears in top kernels -- the range/Rayleigh matvecs are NOT the bottleneck (mega_eigh 35.8%, trsm 17.3%, Gram 6.6% dominate). Gate-clean on dense s3/s4/s12 (nbad0) but +1-1.4% each (already-tf32 matvecs, casts add launches). s8 rankdef fp16 Rayleigh BREAKS (eig_rel 7.9, orth 428, nbad2). s10 orth 0.415->1.529 nbad1. The compute-heavy low-rank GEMMs were already tf32/3xtf32 (brief-44/54); remaining FP32-SIMT is orthonormalization (off-limits).

t5: restrict fp16 range+Rayleigh to gate-clean dense shapes 3/4/12 (drop fragile s8/s10). Neutral 27327->27346 (noise). s8/s10 restored to parent. Dense fp16: s3 74.3->75.1(+1.1%), s4 45.5->45.97(+1.0%), s12 29.9->30.45(+1.8%), all nbad0. CONFIRMS even tolerant dense shapes don't win from fp16 range/Rayleigh -- already tf32 tensor-core, casts add overhead. Tolerance boundary: dense(3/4/12) tolerate fp16 range/Rayleigh nbad0; rankdef/nearrank(8/10) break (near-null complement).

t6: fp16 on reduced-block WY back-transform (forms G=(I-VTV^T)Z, reduced eigenvectors). CATASTROPHIC 27327->32867. Threaded bt_prec low-rank-only (sign-DC/n=352 untouched). EIG margins stay fine (0.4-0.9) but ORTH explodes 3-7.6x gate -> mass fallback: s3 74.3->121.7 orth 6.013 nbad640/640; s4 45.5->75.4 orth 3.682 nbad60/60; s8 80.9->127.0 orth 7.648 nbad640; s10 90.7->121.1 orth 4.845 nbad60; s12 29.9->59.5 orth 3.211 nbad60. DECISIVE: WY back-transform forms reduced eigenvectors G whose orthonormality needs >fp16 (same chain as Vd). Back-transform OUT.

t7: fp16 on A@Qd POWER-step matvec (shapes 4/10). GATE-CLEAN, neutral 27327->27287. Power matvec feeds CQR2 which re-orthonormalizes -> fp16 error SELF-CORRECTED: s4 45.5->46.0(+1.1%) eig0.776 orth0.532 nbad0; s10 90.7->90.2(-0.4%) eig0.404 orth 0.415->0.355 (IMPROVED!) nbad0. First gate-clean non-regressing fp16 route in low-rank family. Speedup small (megakernel dominates s10 66%; casts offset 3->1 GEMM). Neutral metric.

t8: combine fp16 range+Rayleigh+power on 1024 shapes. WORSE than power-only 27287->27363. Range-finder fp16 broke shape10 (orth 0.355->2.042 nbad0->1, near-rank Qd0 span matters). Range+Rayleigh on s12 orth 0.561->0.891 + slowdown (already-tf32 cast overhead). Power-only (t7) is best gate-clean config. Reverting to power-only.

t9: power-only fp16 (best config) + profile shape10. Profile confirms mechanism works: power step's 3 3xtf32 GEMMs GONE (tf32gemm 256x256 20->17 instances, 2.09->1.68ms), replaced by 1 fp16 bmm, net ~0.4ms saved on 90ms shape (mega_eigh_clust 66.8% out of scope). All target 1024 shapes gate-clean nbad0, s10 orth 0.355 (self-corrected). Metric 27572 (parent within 1% noise; s10 90.22/s4 45.9/s12 30.1 stable). Addressable low-rank GEMM time is small vs the reduced-block megakernel + CQR2 trsm.

t10: ISOLATE fp16 on n=512 projections (without Vd lift). STILL CATASTROPHIC 27327->32256. Projections build Vc orthogonal to Qd; fp16 leaves residual Qd-components -> breaks V=[Vd,Vc] CROSS-BLOCK orth (complement CQR2 cant fix cross-block leakage, unlike power step's same-subspace self-correction): s3 74.3->230.0ms(+209%); s8 80.9->232.7(+188%). The brief's named projection GEMMs do NOT tolerate fp16. Projections OUT.

t11 FINAL: power-only fp16 (gate-clean neutral), all other fp16 sites reverted. Tolerance map: TOLERATE fp16 = A@Qd power matvec on n=1024 (CQR2-self-corrected, nbad0). DO NOT tolerate = Vd lift (t3 orth->1.2-1.5 mass fallback), WY back-transform (t6 orth 3-7.6x), n=512 projections (t10 cross-block leak +188-209%), range/Rayleigh (t2/t4/t5 already-tf32 no speedup +1-4%, near-rank Rayleigh breaks). Metric 27342==parent within 1% noise: s3 74.6M(parent) s4 46.1M s8 81.0M(parent) s10 90.1M(-0.6% orth0.355) s12 30.3M. Profile: tf32gemm 256x256 12->11 (power tf32->fp16); mega_eigh 44.6%+trsm 13.1%+FP32-SIMT Gram/Vd all out-of-scope/off-limits. Scaffolding+LR_GATE_DBG in place.

brief-107 (fp16 for low-rank peel + cluster-path GEMMs, shapes 3/4/8/10/12) -- 11 trials, comprehensive precision-tolerance map. Best committed = power-only fp16 (HEAD 8496bb49d, metric 27342 == parent 27327 within 1% noise, 39/39 valid). NO net win found; the brief's precision-limited hypothesis for the ill-conditioned low-rank bases is CONFIRMED.

TOLERANCE MAP (all sites gate-guarded, LR_GATE_DBG diagnostic added):
 TOLERATES fp16 (gate-clean nbad0): A@Qd POWER matvec on n=1024 (self-corrected by the CQR2 that re-orthonormalizes Qd) -- s10 orth even IMPROVED 0.415->0.355. But ~neutral: on n=1024 av_mode was already tf32/3xtf32 (tensor-core), so fp16 only saved ~0.4ms on s10 (mega_eigh_clust is 66.8%).
 DOES NOT tolerate fp16 (precision-limited -> mass cuSOLVER fallback, metric +34-209%):
  - Vd=Qd@G lift (t3): dominant eigenvectors, orth 0.5->1.2-1.5, 100% fallback all n=1024
  - WY back-transform G=(I-VTV^T)Z (t6): reduced eigenvectors, orth 3-7.6x gate, 100% fallback
  - n=512 projections R-Qd(Qd^T R) (t10 ISOLATED): cross-block Vc<->Qd orth leakage, s3+209%/s8+188%
  - A@Omega range + A@Vc Rayleigh (t2/t4/t5): already tf32 (no TC speedup), casts regress +1-4%; near-rank/rankdef complement Rayleigh BREAKS (s8 orth 428, s10 orth 1.5-2.0)
ROOT CAUSE: unlike shape 11's NS sign iterations (iteration-count-limited -> fp16 absorbed), the low-rank family's compute-heavy GEMMs were ALREADY moved to tf32/3xtf32 tensor cores by brief-44/54, and the only remaining FP32-SIMT GEMMs (CQR2 Gram, Vd lift, WY back-transform, projections) all feed EIGENVECTOR ORTHONORMALITY, which needs >fp16. The eig margins stay clean under fp16 everywhere; it is always the ORTH margin that breaks.

OPEN DIRECTIONS for the manager (this line cannot reach them):
 1. The dominant addressable cost is NOT precision but the reduced-block eigh MEGAKERNEL (mega_eigh_med/clust_split_k: 22-67% per target shape) + the CholeskyQR2 batch_trsm (13-22%) -- both out-of-scope here. A brief attacking the k>448 cluster megakernel (s4 k608/s10 k768) or a faster batched orthonormalization than CQR2's trsm would move these shapes far more than any GEMM-precision knob.
 2. fp8/nvfp4 on the SAME power matvec (the one self-corrected site) -- fp8 is ~4500 TFLOPS (2x fp16). Untested; the CQR2 that absorbed fp16 there might absorb fp8's coarser error too on the well-conditioned dense shapes.
 3. Pre-cast A to fp16 ONCE and reuse across matvecs (I left per-call .half()); would shrink the cast overhead that offset the power-fp16 GEMM saving, possibly flipping the neutral power-fp16 to a small win.
 4. An orth-restoring correction (one extra NS/Gram-Schmidt step) AFTER an fp16 Vd lift or back-transform -- could let the compute-heavy orth-critical lifts run fp16 if the cheap correction restores orthonormality under the gate; untested.
 The per-site fp16 routing scaffolding (_LR_*_FP16_SET + _lr_*_mode_for) + LR_GATE_DBG are all in place on HEAD for a follow-up to flip specific (n,k) sites.
